Temple of Swords#002.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#003.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#004.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#005.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#007.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#008.src: The dust is disturbed around it. Someone has been here recently..
Temple of Swords#008.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#009.src: But why would they take whatever was here, but not all the gold?
Temple of Swords#009.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#010.src: Whatever was kept here, I think we can assume it was of great value to the Emperor.
Temple of Swords#010.speaker: Junes

Temple of Swords#011.src: We better get out of here, and don't even think about taking this gold - They are artifacts!
Temple of Swords#011.speaker: Junes
